privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.body:
Controller: [name and address to be added]

What we store: your Google login, username, display name, birth year, optional home region and photo, and what you check in. Your location is only used to check whether you are near a venue. Only the result is stored, never the location. Photos are stripped of their metadata before upload.

Where: Supabase, EU region (Frankfurt). There is no tracking and there are no analytics cookies. The map only loads when you open it: its tiles come from OpenFreeMap, which then sees your IP address.

Your rights: you can export your data as JSON and delete your account in the settings at any time. Add further rights and the legal bases here.

terms.title: Terms of use
terms.body:
GSTLST is 16+. The app doesn't replace age checks at events.

Photos: upload only photos you may share, and no close-ups of strangers without their consent. Photos are visible to others only after approval, and we can remove content.

Reporting: use the report button on photos and profiles. Reported content is hidden until it has been reviewed.

Add further terms here.
